description: Branch R-PRESERVE-1 rollback (and R-TXN-1 write-behind, public side). On a copy of the fail fixture, each step a read/write open, Workspaces(0).BeginTrans, an insert into Big, Rollback or CommitTrans, a row count read, close, and a kept whole-file hash: (1) one row, Rollback; (2) 3,600 rows of about 200 characters (large enough to push dirty pages out of the cache), Rollback; (3) the same 3,600 rows, CommitTrans, as the control. Asks whether a rolled-back transaction leaves the bytes unchanged at both sizes, which would explain why a smaller rollback earlier left the hash equal, and what a commit changes.
retentionNote: Designed r-q-fmt-sort probe (A-02); complete capture of the ACE answer.
